_comment1: Get your API credentials from https://my.telegram.org/apps
_comment2: Leave sessionId empty - it will be auto-filled after first login

downloadSettings._comment3: Number of files to download simultaneously (1-10 recommended)
downloadSettings._comment4: Higher values = faster but more resource intensive
downloadSettings._comment5: Skip files that already exist and have content
downloadSettings._comment6: Number of times to retry failed downloads (0-10)
downloadSettings._comment7: Delay between retry attempts in milliseconds
downloadSettings._comment8: Timeout for each download in milliseconds (5 minutes = 300000)
downloadSettings._comment10: Larger chunks = faster but more memory usage

dateFilter._comment11: Enable date filtering to download only messages in a date range
dateFilter._comment12: Start date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)
dateFilter._comment13: Leave empty to start from beginning
dateFilter._comment15: Leave empty to go until the end

exportSettings._comment16: Directory where downloads will be saved
exportSettings._comment17: Save message metadata to JSON file
exportSettings._comment19: Types of media to download (remove types you don't want)
